response.justification: Bogdan is a versatile, experienced full-stack/systems engineer with strong DLang, TypeScript, and distributed-systems exposure, but he does not meet the core minimum qualifications for this role: he lacks anything close to 8 years of C++ experience (only a brief ~6 months at National Instruments), has no demonstrated large-scale cloud compute platform leadership experience, and no evidence of formal technical leadership/mentoring of cloud or DevOps engineers. His background is a poor match for a C++-centric cloud compute platform tech lead role.
strengths: 15+ years of diverse, high-quality software engineering experience across many stacks
Demonstrated leadership in low-latency/distributed systems work (Dunnhumby/Sociomantic microservices)
Strong community involvement, mentoring via workshops, talks, and open-source project ownership
concerns: Minimal C++ experience (only a few months), far short of the required 8 years
No evidence of production cloud compute platform architecture or leading cloud/DevOps teams
Career shows broad generalist/full-stack focus rather than deep infrastructure or hardware-level systems specialization

key_factors.factor: Lack of cloud compute platform leadership experience
Strong general distributed systems and mentoring background
